events.headline: SoftBank reports $7 billion quarterly loss on US AI data-centre costs
events.summary: SoftBank reported a $7 billion quarterly net loss, including a $3.7 billion charge for revised US AI data-centre power-equipment plans. Financing costs more than doubled to $2.9 billion.

events.headline: China expands automated port technology and AI customs systems
events.summary: China is promoting driverless port vehicles, automated terminals and AI-enabled customs ahead of the APEC summit. Western analysts warn that foreign reliance on Chinese port software could create strategic dependencies.

events.headline: Impossible Metals reports deep-sea test of autonomous mineral-collection robot
events.summary: Impossible Metals said its AI-powered robot retrieved about 450 grams of polymetallic nodules from depths beyond 4,000 meters in a September test. Commercial deployment still requires regulatory approval.

events.headline: Disney and Adobe partner on private generative AI models
events.summary: Disney and Adobe agreed to co-develop proprietary models trained on Disney intellectual property for theme parks, studios and sports media. Disney said its existing generative design tools have shortened some creative iteration cycles.

events.headline: Google introduces two TPU variants for regulated and large-context AI workloads
events.summary: Google unveiled the 8tx and 8i Max TPU variants, targeting protected data processing and large-memory AI workloads. The expansion increases competition with Nvidia for enterprise cloud AI computing.

events.headline: Banks tighten scrutiny of AI infrastructure debt after market selloff
events.summary: Lenders are reassessing AI data-centre financing, including contract guarantees, completion deadlines and customer termination rights. Goldman Sachs forecasts hyperscaler debt issuance rising from $250 billion in 2026 to $420 billion in 2027.

events.headline: US stocks rally as oil declines, despite Nvidia weakness
events.summary: The S&P 500 rose 2.35% and Nasdaq 2.74% as lower oil prices eased inflation worries. Nvidia declined 4.2% even as the semiconductor index rebounded 6.9%.

events.headline: Citigroup downgrades US equities to neutral on AI positioning risk
events.summary: Citigroup strategists reduced US equities to neutral from overweight after AI-related volatility and concerns about spending and regulation. They warned Nasdaq positioning could reset toward net short.
